measures.title: School District of Darlington County general obligation bonds
measures.summary: Asks whether the Darlington County Board of Education may issue up to $250,000,000 in general obligation bonds of the School District of Darlington County. The money would pay for a new Hartsville High School, a new Spaulding Middle School, a new Darlington Elementary School, and safety, security and other upgrades to school district facilities, plus related costs such as technology and land.
measures.yesMeans: The school board could borrow up to $250 million through bonds for the listed school construction and upgrades.
measures.noMeans: The school board would not be authorized to issue these bonds.
